location_exception_reason: Mild Steel Portable Houses are manufactured commodities with nationwide supply chains; location of origin does not materially affect buyer decision-making. No GI protection or regional origin claim applies.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product meaning unchanged.
